detail: Harden the three chronically flaky native-gates jobs measured on 2026-08-02: flutter-ios gate budget could not fit its own three retry tiers (2400s budget, --no-dds retry tiers with per-attempt dds evidence, 150s retry idle bound), swiftui-ios 900s budget expired during teardown of an already-passing run (now 1800s), and container gates now retry docker build only on transient registry network errors, bounded at three attempts.
